# Was the Tower Records Japan data breach a hack?

**Confirmed.** Yes: Tower Records says an outside party got into Tower Records Online without authorisation on Nov 19 and customer data leaked. How they got in and who they are are not established.

Incident: Tower Records Japan data breach, Nov 2026. Also reported as the Tower Records Online breach and the Tower Records Japan leak. First published Nov 22, 2026; last updated Nov 22, 2026, 11:18 AM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Tower Records Japan, Nikkei, Investing.com or any other company, news outlet, government agency, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 22, 2026, 11:18 AM ET: **Tower Records Japan says an outside party got into its online shop and about 11 million records leaked; card data not included.** First build from the company's own notice (Tier 1, read Nov 22), Nikkei and Investing.com (both relay the notice, so one source behind it). c001 unauthorised access Confirmed; c003 to c007 data and counts Confirmed from the notice; c008 and c009 Reported (company snapshot and plans). How they got in, who, and any link to other retailer incidents Not established. Nikkei read only in part (subscription). Privacy check done: no staff, officials or contacts named; help-desk links and phone details left out.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. About 11 million records of customer data, from a retailer's online shop, per the company. Counts overlap and the number of distinct people is not published.
- Who is affected: Tower Records members, including some who left within three years. Leaked: email, member ID, password hash, and for some, name, birth date, address or phone. Card data was not, per the company.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 11M | Records leaked | About, per the company; counts overlap |
| 10.2M | Login records | Email, member ID, password hash |
| 2.78M | Member profiles | Name, birth date, sex, postcode |
| 777K | Shipping records | Address, name, phone |

### Known so far

- An outside party got into Tower Records Online without authorisation on Nov 19.
- The company stopped the shop at about 5:10 PM JST and it is still offline for checks.
- About 11 million records leaked, including people who left within three years.
- 10,214,652 login records: email, member ID and password hash.
- No credit card information was included, per the company.

### Not known yet

- How the attacker got in.
- Who the attacker was.
- Whether the data has been used against customers.
